lifecycle.transition_rule: Transitions require evidence or an explicit governed disposition; run success alone cannot advance lifecycle.

status.rule: Status is not progress, health, lifecycle, or authority.

progress.rule: If denominator is undefined or incomparable, value MUST be null and basis MUST explain UNKNOWN.

semantics.GREEN: Observed operating/control condition satisfies its declared current gate; not automatic mission closure.
semantics.AMBER: Active risk, wait, partial proof, or bounded unresolved dependency.
semantics.RED: Observed blocking failure against the mission's current gate.
semantics.GREY: Insufficient current evidence; unknown is not green.

metrics.unknown_policy: Use null plus evidence_state=UNKNOWN; never coerce missing to zero.
metrics.extensibility: Mission-specific metrics live under metrics.custom with units and denominator metadata.

crew.rule: Crew is logical accountability/capability. It is not the runner substrate.

runners.rule: Runner metrics are execution telemetry; they do not create crew or authority credit.

todo.rule: DONE means the action is done; CONTROL means prevention/detection/re-entry control exists. Neither alone means the mission is CLOSED.

execution_hierarchy.cardinality: One mission may have many sprints; each sprint many waves; each wave many pulses; each pulse zero or many runs.
execution_hierarchy.zero_run_pulse: Allowed for planning/classification/hold decisions; it MUST NOT be represented as successful execution.

g3p_optional_receipt.unknown_policy: Null means unknown, never zero. Numeric % requires numerators/denominators and exact source match.
g3p_optional_receipt.blocked_policy: Local lane HOLD may advance the pulse ordinal with evidence and safe alternate work; global blocker leaves future ordinals NOT_RUN.
g3p_optional_receipt.acceptance_policy: Pulse success not merge admission; independently require security/A10/governance/coverage/review.
g3p_optional_receipt.traceability: Prior pulse next_source_sha must match subsequent pulse input_source_sha unless explicit observed source drift triggers HOLD.
